captions.detailed: This 3D model features a three-branch fixture head for a bench machine, consisting of a vertical central mast with a dark grey base and cap. Three radial arms are mounted to the mast via separate cubic hub blocks staggered at different heights. Each light grey arm projects outward, terminating in a small square mounting pad, and is supported by a revolute joint that allows independent rotational movement around its local hub axis.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a three-branch fixture head with a central vertical mast. The mast should feature three radial arms attached at staggered heights on separate hub blocks, each with a revolute joint allowing independent rotation and ending in a mounting pad.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by creating a vertical cylinder for the main mast, capped with a wider, thin cylinder at the top and a thick base cylinder at the bottom. Three separate arm assemblies are built, each starting with a cubic hub block attached to the mast at staggered vertical positions and rotated around the Z-axis. Each arm is composed of a joint cylinder, a rectangular extension bar, and a thin square mounting pad at the tip, connected via revolute joints to their respective hubs.
